name: delegate
summary: Hand subtasks to other agent CLIs on this machine and keep every run as plain files a person can review; the shared agent handbook, project snapshots and a stdio MCP server for the main agent.
needs: an agent CLI you are signed in to

delegate.about: hand a task to another agent CLI and record it (--help for options)

doctor.about: check each agent CLI: installed, version, signed in; --probe asks each for one word

handbook.about: show where the agent handbook is, or create it (init)

mcp.about: stdio MCP server with the delegation tools, for a main agent (--project <dir>)

snapshot.about: take, list, changes, diff and restore snapshots of a project
